status: $3,000 TOTAL DIY spending ceilings, not verified procurement prices or approved occupied designs
assumptions: A person inside is essential. Seed surrounds and occupied zorbs are new concepts; earlier eight options remain unoccupied comparisons.

$3,000 TOTAL is the current DIY cap, with only unspecified slight flexibility. Grant, fundraising and owner money describe who pays; they do not enlarge the baseline. The quoted Seed Grant tier is user-supplied.
Dry land, stationary use, supervised operation, direct egress and no occupant suspension in either priced seed option. Exact model, ventilation, wind limits and event acceptance remain unresolved.

Amounts are spending ceilings to test against quotes, not found prices. Andrew has a pipe bender and denhac access; fabrication labor is in-kind. Odd Todd is a potential collaborator. Known stock, donor condition, tool capacity and agreed hours remain unresolved. No salvage discount is booked.

One common holder: six-foot seating loop and low triangle. Ground mode uses detachable lander legs; suspended mode uses webbing over the sphere and an aerial rig. The wood platform is removed. Camera arms can attach to the triangle. Ground-holder/leg materials share one allocation; optional rigging/rig and cameras remain unpriced.
LED lighting is included; projector ownership is unconfirmed, so projection and live capture are excluded from the seed core. No water, truck support, internal camera or occupied haze is included.

The occupied-zorb sphere ceiling includes delivery and tax. Contingency defaults to 25%, producing a $600 reserve on $2,400 of allocations. Extra tax, higher quotes or altered settings can exceed the cap and must be shown. Credits are for identified avoided costs, not hoped-for funding.
